verdict.rationale: Recurly documents configurable, domain-specific automations that run in the background. Merchants can set up dunning campaigns that control retries, emails and outcomes for failed payments, and a standalone retry engine that manages the entire recovery lifecycle. A community comparison confirms these retention automations work without custom webhooks. However, these are fixed billing-recovery workflows, not general-purpose, user-defined or agentic automations. Missing for 10: a general automation/workflow builder, AI-driven or agentic background tasks, user-defined triggers and actions beyond dunning, and scheduling controls for arbitrary jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Dunning Management controls how Recurly handles failed payments — what emails are sent, when retries occur, and what happens if a subscriber never pays.
plug Recurly's optimized dunning into your existing billing stack and let it manage the entire recovery lifecycle.
merchants on Professional and Elite plans can create up to 50 targeted campaigns for different customer segments or plans
Recurly appears to offer more automated customer retention features (no need to implement webhooks to send dunning emails)
